import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

ref_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\data\file_generation_en\reference\FG_136\middle_school_student_grades-grade9_filtered_results_res.xlsx"
pred_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\runs\aida-ctrl\work\FG_136\middle_school_student_grades-grade9_filtered_results.xlsx"

# Load normal scores sheets
ref_normal = pd.read_excel(ref_file, sheet_name='Students with normal scores')
pred_normal = pd.read_excel(pred_file, sheet_name='Students with normal scores')

# Compare Student IDs first
ref_ids = set(ref_normal['Student ID'].values)
pred_ids = set(pred_normal['Student ID'].values)

print(f"Normal scores sheet:")
print(f"  Ref Student IDs count: {len(ref_ids)}")
print(f"  Pred Student IDs count: {len(pred_ids)}")
print(f"  Student IDs match: {ref_ids == pred_ids}")

if ref_ids != pred_ids:
    missing_in_pred = ref_ids - pred_ids
    extra_in_pred = pred_ids - ref_ids
    print(f"  Missing in predicted: {len(missing_in_pred)}")
    if len(missing_in_pred) > 0:
        print(f"    First 10: {sorted(list(missing_in_pred))[:10]}")
    print(f"  Extra in predicted: {len(extra_in_pred)}")
    if len(extra_in_pred) > 0:
        print(f"    First 10: {sorted(list(extra_in_pred))[:10]}")
else:
    print("  Student IDs are identical - proceeding with sampling comparison")
    
    # Sort both by Student ID for comparison
    ref_sorted = ref_normal.sort_values('Student ID').reset_index(drop=True)
    pred_sorted = pred_normal.sort_values('Student ID').reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Sample for comparison: head, tail, middle, random
    n_rows = len(ref_sorted)
    sample_size = 50
    
    # Get sample indices
    head_indices = list(range(min(sample_size, n_rows)))
    tail_indices = list(range(max(0, n_rows - sample_size), n_rows))
    middle_start = n_rows // 2 - sample_size // 2
    middle_indices = list(range(max(0, middle_start), min(n_rows, middle_start + sample_size)))
    
    # Random sample
    np.random.seed(42)
    random_indices = list(np.random.choice(n_rows, min(sample_size, n_rows), replace=False))
    
    all_sample_indices = sorted(set(head_indices + tail_indices + middle_indices + random_indices))
    
    print(f"\n  Comparing {len(all_sample_indices)} sampled rows")
    
    # Compare sampled rows
    ref_sample = ref_sorted.iloc[all_sample_indices]
    pred_sample = pred_sorted.iloc[all_sample_indices]
    
    all_match = True
    for col in ref_sample.columns:
        ref_col = ref_sample[col].values
        pred_col = pred_sample[col].values
        
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(ref_sample[col]):
            match = np.allclose(ref_col, pred_col, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6, equal_nan=True)
        else:
            match = all(str(r) == str(p) for r, p in zip(ref_col, pred_col))
        
        if not match:
            all_match = False
            print(f"    Column '{col}' has mismatches in sample")
    
    print(f"\n  All sampled rows match: {all_match}")
